node.statement: Apply lem-compcb-rectangular-product at square amplification level n to the compatible pair (A_0,B). For e at the common threshold fixed in node 1.1, it gives ||A_0 dot B-A_0B|| <= C e ||A_0|| ||B|| = C e r^2. Substituting the norm identity from the preceding block computation yields ||h u_Q-X^dagger X|| <= C e r^2. Thus the notation (X^dagger,X) in node 1.3.2 is rigorously realized by their canonical zero-padded square representatives (A_0,B), not by feeding nonsquare matrices to the theorem.
